mapper.select: SELECT d.id AS destination_id, dt.name, dt.short_description, ( SELECT di.image_url FROM destination_images di WHERE di.destination_id = d.id AND di.is_main = 1 ORDER BY di.order_index ASC, di.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS image_url FROM destinations d JOIN destination_translations dt ON dt.destination_id = d.id AND dt.language_code = 'ko' WHERE d.region_id = #{regionId} AND d.is_public = 1 ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT #{limit}

WITH RECURSIVE child_regions AS ( SELECT child.id AS candidate_id, child.id AS region_id FROM country_categories child WHERE child.parent_id = #{countryId} AND child.is_visible = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT child_regions.candidate_id, descendant.id AS region_id FROM child_regions JOIN country_categories descendant ON descendant.parent_id = child_regions.region_id AND descendant.is_visible = 1 ), eligible_children AS ( SELECT DISTINCT child.id AS region_id, child.region_name AS region_name FROM country_categories child JOIN child_regions ON child_regions.candidate_id = child.id JOIN destinations destination ON destination.region_id = child_regions.region_id AND destination.is_public = 1 JOIN destination_translations translation ON translation.destination_id = destination.id AND translation.language_code = 'ko' WHERE child.parent_id = #{countryId} AND child.is_visible = 1 ) SELECT country.id AS country_id, country.region_name AS country_name, eligible_children.region_id, eligible_children.region_name FROM eligible_children JOIN country_categories country ON country.id = #{countryId} ORDER BY
CASE WHEN eligible_children.region_id = #{excludeRegionId} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
RAND() LIMIT 1

WITH RECURSIVE region_tree AS ( SELECT id FROM country_categories WHERE id = #{regionId} AND is_visible = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT child.id FROM country_categories child JOIN region_tree ON child.parent_id = region_tree.id WHERE child.is_visible = 1 ) SELECT id FROM region_tree
